name: PCR patient transfer, sensitivity and cell-source interpretation v1
scope: Complete computational extension using existing DepMap/TCGA development data and independent GEO single-cell expression; no patient functional labels

pcr.expression_space: 15835 baseline genes, distinct from recovered DeepDEP 6016 feature positions
pcr.targets: TCGA-covered release-wide non-common-essential genes with observed training dependency
pcr.training: non-Kidney DepMap 24Q4 models, purging patients shared with Kidney
pcr.hyperparameters: Reuse historical Kidney outer-fold PCR config selected only within non-Kidney training data in selective_dependency_benchmark_v1/tuning.csv; validate source hash and training cohort
pcr.target: dependency minus training gene mean; lower is stronger predicted selective dependency
pcr.test_policy: Never load or predict TCGA Locked Test expression; check identifiers against metadata only
pcr.candidate_policy: New PCR development candidates are separate from historical frozen 20; discovery uses Train only; no reranking by Validation or single-cell results

mapping.fit: TCGA Train mean only; Kidney reference expression is an explicitly labeled unlabeled sensitivity

uncertainty.source_sampling: Sample non-Kidney DepMap patients with replacement within each lineage; include all models for each selected patient, refit standardization/PCA/PCR at fixed hyperparameters
uncertainty.source_mapping: Keep historical expression bridge fixed while resampling training models, to separate model-fit from mapping uncertainty
uncertainty.mapping_sampling: Resample TCGA Train patients with replacement, refit non-Kidney mean shift, hold PCR fixed
uncertainty.interpretation: Descriptive resampling stability, not calibrated probability of functional dependency; 50 draws are a bounded initial analysis

singlecell.data: Author-supplied 10x raw counts and ccRCC/normal cell annotation; exclude chRCC tumor samples
singlecell.selection: Select by metadata completeness and ccRCC/normal coverage before inspecting candidate expression
singlecell.annotation: Preserve author annotation; audit identity joins and marker expression; never infer malignancy from a candidate alone
singlecell.qc: Use author-annotated cells with >=200 detected genes and <=20% mitochondrial counts; show excluded counts by sample and label; no new doublet classifier
singlecell.unit: donor x tissue x broad cell group; cells are not independent biological replicates
singlecell.aggregation: Sum raw counts and normalize pseudobulk to CPM; detection fraction from raw counts
singlecell.report: Patient-level expression/detection and equal-donor group summaries for Train-discovered PCR top20 plus historical frozen20 (separate flags)
singlecell.mixture_sensitivity: Within each ccRCC donor compare tumor-cell and all-cell pseudobulk, plus 25/50/75% nonmalignant RNA mixtures; align each scenario to non-Kidney reference by a scenario-specific donor-mean shift; report exploratory rankings only
singlecell.constraints: No new model or mapping selection from single-cell outcomes; cross-protocol scRNA CPM and DepMap TPM do not establish dependency accuracy; normal tissues may be paired with tumor donors and are not automatically independent healthy controls

limitations: Existing development datasets have been examined historically
No clinical efficacy or safety claim
Single-cell independent expression cohort is not independent dependency validation
